diff --git a/src/click/live_cached_stream.py b/src/click/live_cached_stream.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3ab9703
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/click/live_cached_stream.py
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+import typing as t
+from weakref import WeakKeyDictionary
+
+
+def live_cached_stream(
+    src_func: t.Callable[[], t.TextIO | None],
+    wrapper_func: t.Callable[[], t.TextIO],
+) -> t.Callable[[], t.TextIO | None]:
+    """Like ``_make_cached_stream_func`` in ``_compat``, but a cached
+    wrapper that has been closed is treated as a cache miss and replaced
+    with a fresh wrapper.
+    """
+    cache: cabc.MutableMapping[t.TextIO, t.TextIO] = WeakKeyDictionary()
+
+    def func() -> t.TextIO | None:
+        stream = src_func()
+
+        if stream is None:
+            return None
+
+        try:
+            rv = cache.get(stream)
+
+            if rv is not None and getattr(rv, "closed", False):
+                rv = None
+        except Exception:
+            rv = None
+        if rv is not None:
+            return rv
+        rv = wrapper_func()
+        try:
+            cache[stream] = rv
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+        return rv
+
+    return func
diff --git a/tests/test_live_cached_stream.py b/tests/test_live_cached_stream.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4853977
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_live_cached_stream.py
@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+import io
+
+from click.live_cached_stream import live_cached_stream
+
+
+def _make(src):
+    created = []
+
+    def wrapper():
+        rv = io.StringIO()
+        created.append(rv)
+        return rv
+
+    return live_cached_stream(lambda: src[0], wrapper), created
+
+
+def test_returns_cached_wrapper():
+    src = [io.StringIO()]
+    func, created = _make(src)
+    assert func() is func()
+    assert len(created) == 1
+
+
+def test_closed_wrapper_is_cache_miss():
+    src = [io.StringIO()]
+    func, created = _make(src)
+    first = func()
+    first.close()
+    second = func()
+    assert second is not first
+    assert not second.closed
+    assert func() is second
+    assert len(created) == 2
+
+
+def test_none_source_returns_none():
+    func, created = _make([None])
+    assert func() is None
+    assert created == []
+
+
+def test_new_source_gets_new_wrapper():
+    src = [io.StringIO()]
+    func, created = _make(src)
+    first = func()
+    src[0] = io.StringIO()
+    assert func() is not first
+
+
+def test_unhashable_source_not_cached():
+    class Unhashable(io.StringIO):
+        __hash__ = None
+
+    func, created = _make([Unhashable()])
+    assert func() is not func()
+    assert len(created) == 2
+
+
+def test_closed_raises_is_cache_miss():
+    class Broken(io.StringIO):
+        @property
+        def closed(self):
+            raise ValueError("detached")
+
+    src = [io.StringIO()]
+    made = []
+
+    def wrapper():
+        made.append(Broken())
+        return made[-1]
+
+    func = live_cached_stream(lambda: src[0], wrapper)
+    assert func() is not func()
+    assert len(made) == 2
notes:
Copied _make_cached_stream_func into live_cached_stream, adding a closed check on the cached wrapper inside the existing try so a closed (or closed-raising) wrapper is a cache miss and gets replaced; _compat.py untouched. Added tests/test_live_cached_stream.py.
